summary: Project includes account password-reset functionality implemented via user-defined security questions (set during signup), with email disabled.
architectural_notes: Email is disabled; password reset must not rely on email delivery.
Security questions are user-defined and must be configured during signup; password reset requires answering 2+ questions.
known_issues: Build/deployment attempt failed with error: 'AI couldn't implement that request'; user requested a retry.

existing_features.title: Add a frontend “Security Questions Setup” step that occurs during initial onboarding (interpreted as the user’s first successful Internet Identity sign-in): if the authenticated user has not set security questions yet, prompt them to create at least two custom questions and answers before continuing to the dashboard/camera experience.
Add a frontend “Account Recovery” page for authenticated users that verifies their security-question answers and, upon success, allows them to reset/change their security questions (no email flow).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add password reset flow using security questions (user-defined; require 2+; set up during signup; no email)

Extend the backend user account data to support user-defined security questions that are set up on first sign-in: store at least two question/answer pairs per principal and expose whether the caller has completed security-question setup.

Add backend endpoints to (a) set initial security questions for the authenticated caller and (b) verify answers for the authenticated caller, enabling a recovery flow that allows the caller to reset/change their security questions after successful verification.

If adding new persistent backend state to support security questions changes stable data structures, add/adjust backend upgrade migration logic according to the project’s conditional migration policy so upgrades do not trap or lose existing user profiles.

projectName: Add account recovery via user-defined security questions (2+ required)
